EXCLUSIVE BUYER REPRESENTATION AGREEMENT

This Exclusive Buyer Representation Agreement is between Marlow Realty Group ("Broker") and Dana Okafor ("Buyer").

1. Appointment. Buyer appoints Broker as Buyer's exclusive agent to locate and negotiate the purchase of residential real property in Travis County.

2. Term. This Agreement begins on June 1, 2026 and ends on November 30, 2026.

3. Compensation. Broker's compensation is 2.5% of the purchase price, payable at closing. Broker may not receive compensation from any source that exceeds this amount.

4. Broker compensation is not set by law and is fully negotiable.
